item.title: Charlotte (NC) Added ‘Highly Specialized’ Fire Apparatus Last Year. It Already Needs Repairs
item.description: Charlotte (NC) spent nearly $1.9 million on a tiller truck in 2024. A series of repairs has kept it sidelined for much of its first year in service. item.title: 3M™ Scott™ Fire & Safety Announces SCBA NFPA 1970 Compliance

item.title: ‘We Never Had to Close’ Hall of Flame Curator Says
item.description: The Hall of Flame Museum in Phoenix, Arizona, sustained significant damage from storms in September and October 2025 but remained open. A new drainage system was installed to prevent future issues. item.title: NIOSH: SCBA Did Not Contribute to Houston (TX) Firefighters’ Near Miss in Apartment Fire
item.description: The NPPTL evaluated self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) used in a Houston fire incident, finding no evidence they contributed to firefighters becoming trapped or injured during the rapid fire progression. The post NIOSH: SCBA Did Not Contribute to Houston (TX) Firefighters’ Near Miss in Apartment Fire appeared first on Fire Apparatus: Fire trucks, fire engines, emergency vehicles, and firefighting equipment.

item.title: LA County (CA) Files Lawsuit Against Fire Truck Makers
item.description: The county is suing a private equity firm, American Industrial Partners, and fire truck makers REV Group, Oshkosh Corp. and Boise Mobile Equipment for allegedly violating federal and state antitrust laws.
